Makiyi aya anochengetwa akavharirwa paanenge asiri kushandiswa uye anoshandiswa chete kuita mabasa aunokumbira.

2.4. Data reZviri Mukati: mafaira emedia nezvinhu zvaunorodha kana kugadzira paPlatform — kusanganisira mifananidzo inoshandiswa kugadzira maavatar emifananidzo, marekodhi ezwi anoshandiswa kutevedzera izwi, mavhidhiyo, zvinyorwa, subtitles, brand kits uye zvinyorwa zvakagadzirwa — pamwe chete nemibvunzo yako yezvinofambiswa, tsanangudzo dzechigadzirwa nevaoni, mazwi akakosha, uye zvinongedzo kumavhidhiyo echitatu aunotumira kuti aongororwe.

2.5. Data reTekinoroji: IP kero, mhando yebrowser, JWT authorisation tokens uye zvinyorwa zvechiitiko zvakakosha kuchengetedza uye kugadzirisa matambudziko.

2.6. Data reSocial Media rinowanikwa pachena: kupa ongororo yezvinofambiswa, Platform inotora zviri pachena uye metrics yekubatana (mavhidhiyo, machaneli, kuona/kufarira kuverenga, captions) kubva kuTikTok, Instagram uye YouTube kuburikidza nemupi wedata ane rezinesi TikHub. Data iri rinowanikwa kubva kunzvimbo dzinowanikwa pachena kwete kubva kune vanhu pachavo; rinogadziriswa chete kuverenga ongororo yezvinofambiswa nemisika uye harishandiswe kuita profiling kana kuona vanhu vanoonekwa muzviri mukati.

Mupi anogadzirisa data remunhu kune zvinangwa zvinotevera uye pahwaro hwemutemo hunotevera pasi peChinyorwa 6(1) GDPR:

  • Kuita kwekontrakiti (Art. 6(1)(b)): kugadzira nekuchengetedza account yako, kupa maficha ePlatform (kuwana zvinofambiswa, ongororo yevhidhiyo, AI video studio, kuronga nekuburitsa), kugadzirisa kubhadhara kwekunyoresa uye kupa rutsigiro rwetekinoroji.
  • Kutevedzera zvisungo zvemutemo (Art. 6(1)(c)): mabasa ekuverenga, mutero uye kubhadhara.
  • Zvido zvakakodzera (Art. 6(1)(f)): kuchengetedza Platform, kudzivirira hunyengeri nekushandisa zvisirizvo, kuchengetedza kugadzikana kwebasa, kuchengeta metrics yebasa remukati inochengetedza zvakavanzika, uye kugadzirisa zviri pachena zve social media zve ongororo yezvinofambiswa.
  • Kubvumirana (Art. 6(1)(a)): makuki asiri akakosha uye matekinoroji akafanana (ona Mutemo WemaCookie) uye chero maficha ekuwedzera eremangwana akavakirwa pakubvumirana. Kubvumirana kunogona kubviswa chero nguva zvine simba kune ramangwana.

Platform haiti sarudzo dzakazvimirira dzinoburitsa mhedzisiro yepamutemo kana yakafanana inokosha maererano newe mukati mechinangwa cheChinyorwa 22 GDPR.

sections.h: 4. Mifananidzo, Manzwi uye Zviri Mukati Zvakagadzirwa neAI

Haashandiswe kuita biometric identification kana biometric categorisation yemunhu chero upi zvake, uye haashandiswe neMupi kudzidzisa artificial intelligence models.

4.2. Kana kugadzira avatar kana kutevedzera izwi kuchida kunyoresa zvinhu nemupi weAI wechitatu (semuenzaniso HeyGen kana ElevenLabs), zvinhu zvinotumirwa kumupi iyeye chete kune basa raakumbirwa uye zvinogadziriswa pasi pemitemo yemupi iyeye uye zvibvumirano zvekugadzirisa data.

4.3. Unogona kudzima media yakarodha uye zvinhu zvakagadzirwa mugallery yePlatform chero nguva. Pakudzima account yako, zviri mukati zvine hukama zvinobviswa, kunze kwekunge kuchengetwa kuchidiwa nemutemo (ona Chikamu 7).

4.4. Unofanira kuva nekodzero dzakakodzera uye kubvumirana kwemunhu chero upi zvake ane mufananidzo kana izwi raunorodha kana kutevedzera. Zvisungo zvakadzama zvakatsanangurwa mu Mitemo Yebasa.

sections.h: 5. Kuburitswa KweData Kune Vamwe Vanhu (Vanoita Basa Pasi Pedu)

Kuti Platform ishande, Mupi webasa anoshandisa masevhisi evatatu vanovimbwa navo vanogona kuwana chikamu chedata pasi pezvibvumirano zvakasimba, uye chete kusvika padanho rinodiwa:

  • Zvivakwa uye kugara kwe data: Hostinger (maseva chaiwo ari muEuropean Economic Area; madhatabhesi uye kodhi yekushandisa).
  • Kubhadhara: Stripe (kubhadhara kwekunyoresa, ma invoice, kudzivirira kubiridzira).
  • Artificial intelligence: Google (Gemini models), Anthropic (Claude models), OpenAI, FAL.ai, HeyGen (kugadzira avatar), ElevenLabs (kugadzira kutaura uye kukopa izwi) — kuburikidza neAPI dzavo dzepamutemo. Chete zvirimo zvinodiwa pakushanda kwakananga kwaunokumbira ndizvo zvinotumirwa.
  • Data remagariro evanhu: TikHub (kutora zvirimo zvepuratifomu zvinowanikwa pachena uye metrics).
  • Kuburitsa: Blotato nemasangano evanhu aunobatanidza (TikTok, Meta/Instagram, YouTube/Google) — vanogamuchira zvirimo zvaunoronga kuburitsa uye zvitupa zvawakabatanidza mumakaundi ako.
  • Kusimbisa: Google (sarudzo ye"Sign in with Google").

Paunobatanidza kako API kiyi kana kunyoresa kwesevhisi yechitatu, sevhisi iyoyo inogadzirisa data rako pasi pechibvumirano chako nayo; Mupi webasa anongotumira zvikumbiro zvako pachinzvimbo chako.

Mupi webasa haatengesi data remunhu uye haariushandisi pakushambadzira kwevatatu kana zvinangwa zvekushambadzira.

6.1. Madhatabhesi ePlatform ega uye kodhi yekushandisa inogarwa pamaseva ari mukati meEuropean Economic Area (EEA).

6.2. Vamwe vevapi vebasa vakanyorwa muchikamu 5 (semuenzaniso Stripe, Google, Anthropic, OpenAI, HeyGen, ElevenLabs, FAL.ai, Blotato) vakavambwa muUnited States kana dzimwe nyika dzechitatu. Kutamiswa kune vapi vebasa vakadaro kunoitika pahwaro hwechisungo chekukwana cheEuropean Commission (kusanganisira EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework, kana mupi webasa akasimbiswa) kana pahwaro hweEuropean Commission's Standard Contractual Clauses (Art. 46(2)(c) GDPR) nematanho ekuwedzera pazvinodiwa.

6.3. Kopi yezvidziviriro zvakakodzera inogona kukumbirwa kuburikidza neemail yekubata yakaratidzwa muchikamu 1.

• Data reAkaunti: kwenguva yekunyoresa kana chiitiko cheakaunti. Pakudzima akaunti data rinobviswa, kunze kweruzivo runofanira kuchengetwa kuti rwutevedzere mutemo wemitero uye wekuverenga (kusvika makore mashanu).
  • Data rezvirimo (media, ongororo, mavhidhiyo akagadzirwa): kusvika waabvisa kuburikidza nePlatform kana kuvhara akaunti yako.
  • Makiyi ekuisa (BYOK): kusvika waabvisa muzvirongwa kana kuvhara akaunti yako; akachengetwa akavharidzirwa kwenguva yese.
  • Technical logs: semutemo, kwete kupfuura mwedzi gumi nemiviri, kunze kwekunge nguva yakareba ichidiwa kuongorora zviitiko zvekuchengetedza kana nemutemo.
  • Zvinyorwa zvekubhadhara: kwenguva dzinodiwa nemutemo wemitero unoshanda.

8.1. Mupi webasa anoshandisa matanho ehunyanzvi nehurongwa hwemazuva ano: kutumira data rakavharidzirwa (HTTPS/TLS), hashing yemapasipoti, kuvharidzira makiyi eAPI akachengetwa, kuchengetedza zvikamu zvakavakirwa paJWT, kudzora kupinda uye musimboti wekushoma ropafadzo.

8.2. Kupinda kune data remunhu kunogumira kune vanhu vanorida kuti vashandise Platform uye vanosungirwa nezvisungo zvekuvanzika.

8.3. Kana pakaitika kutyora kwedata remunhu kungangokonzera njodzi kune kodzero dzako nerusununguko, Mupi webasa achazivisa chiremera chekutarisa chine mvumo uye, pazvinodiwa neChikamu 34 GDPR, Vashandisi vakakanganiswa.

Une kodzero yekuti:

  • kukumbira kupinda kune data rako remunhu uye kuwana kopi yaro;
  • kukumbira kugadzirisa data risina kururama kana risina kukwana;

  • kupokana nekugadzirisa kwakavakirwa pazvido zviri pamutemo, pahwaro hwechimiro chako chakananga;

Kuti ushandise kodzero idzi, tumira chikumbiro ku SEO@trendtraffic.pro. Mupi webasa anopindura mukati memwedzi mumwe (inogona kuwedzerwa nemimwe mwedzi miviri yezvikumbiro zvakaoma, nekuzivisa).

Une kodzero zvakare yekumhan'ara kune chiremera chekutarisa — muPoland, Mutungamiri weHofisi Yekudzivirira Data Remunhu (Prezes Urzędu Ochrony Danych Osobowych, UODO, ul. Stawki 2, 00-193 Warszawa, uodo.gov.pl), kana kune chiremera chekutarisa chekugara kwako kwakajairika.

sections.h: 10. Artificial Intelligence uye Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 (EU AI Act)
sections.b:
10.1. Iyo Platform inosanganisa mhando dzeAI dzeveruzhinji dzinowanikwa kubva kune vanopa vechitatu kuburikidza neAPI dzavo dzepamutemo (Google Gemini, Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, HeyGen, ElevenLabs, FAL.ai) yekuongorora maitiro, kugadzira zvinyorwa nemazwi akakosha, kushandura, kuongorora vhidhiyo frame-ne-frame, kugadzira maavatars uye kugadzira kutaura. Mupi haagadziri kana kudzidzisa mhando dzake dzeAI uye haasi mupi wemhando dzeAI dzeveruzhinji mukati mezvinorehwa neRegulation (EU) 2024/1689 ("EU AI Act").

10.2. Kushandiswa kweAI kwePlatform kunowira mukati mezvikamu zvepasi-pasi uye zvine njodzi shoma zveEU AI Act. Iyo Platform haishandisi masisitimu eAI ane njodzi huru mukati mezvinorehwa neAnnex III yeRegulation.

10.3. Kujeka kwezvinyorwa zvakagadzirwa: iyo Platform chishandiso chekugadzira vhidhiyo, odhiyo nemifananidzo zvakagadzirwa neAI uye zvakashandurwa neAI (kusanganisira maavatars nemanzwi akatevedzerwa). Zvimiro zveAI zvinonyatsoonekwa muinterface. Kana vanopa veAI vakaisa zviratidzo zvinoverengwa nemuchina kana ma watermark muzvinyorwa zvakagadzirwa (Chinyorwa 50(2) cheEU AI Act), iyo Platform inozvichengetedza uye haizvibvise. Vashandisi vanosungirwa nekondirakiti kuburitsa deep fakes nezvimwe zvinyorwa zvakagadzirwa sezvinodiwa neChinyorwa 50(4) cheEU AI Act uye nemitemo yemasocial network kwavanoburitsa (ona Terms of Service).

10.4. Maitiro anorambidzwa neChinyorwa 5 cheEU AI Act — kunyengedza kwepasi-pasi, kushandisa zvinokanganisa (kusanganisira zvevana), kuongorora magariro, kuongorora kufungidzira kweutsotsi hwevanhu, kutsvaga zvisina kunangwa kwemifananidzo yechiso kubva pa internet kana CCTV, kuziva manzwiro panzvimbo yebasa uye mudzidzo, kuisa muzvikamu zvinoenderana nebiometric zvichibva pane zvakavanzika, uye kuziva biometric kure-kure munguva chaiyo munzvimbo dzeveruzhinji — hazvipiwi nePlatform, zvinorambidzwa neTerms of Service, uye zvikumbiro zvakanangana nemaitiro akadaro zvinorambidzwa.

10.5. Kutarisa kwevanhu: Zvibereko zveAI (kuongorora, zvinyorwa, mazwi akakosha, mavhidhiyo akagadzirwa) zvinyorwa zvinogona kunge zvisina kururama. Vashandisi vanoongorora uye vanobvumidza zvinyorwa vasati vashandisa kana kuburitsa.

Iyo Platform chishandiso chehunyanzvi chakagadzirirwa vanhu vane makore gumi nemasere ekuzvarwa kana kupfuura. Mupi haazivi kuunganidza data remunhu revana. Kana iwe uchifunga kuti mwana akapa data remunhu kuPlatform, ndapota taura ne SEO@trendtraffic.pro uye data richadzimwa.

Mupi anogona kugadzirisa Mutemo uyu, kunyanya kuratidza shanduko mumutemo kana mukushanda kwePlatform. Shanduro yazvino inogara ichiburitswa paPlatform, ine zuva rekuti "rakagadziriswa kekupedzisira" pamusoro. Kana paine shanduko dzakakosha, Vashandisi vachaziviswawo neemail kana muapp.

sections.h: 6. Mutemo Wekusadzorera Mari uye Kodzero Yekudzima
sections.b:

6.2. Vatengi muEU — kuregererwa kwekodzero yekudzima: zvinoenderana neDirective 2011/83/EU uye Polish Act ya30 Chivabvu 2014 pamusoro peKodzero dzeVatengi (kunyanya zviga zvekuwaniswa kwezviri mukati medhijitari nemasevhisi edhijitari), nekuita kunyoreswa kwakabhadharwa mutengi anonyatso kukumbira nekubvumirana kuti basa ritange nekukurumidza, isati yapera nguva yakajairwa yemazuva gumi nemana yekudzima, uye anobvuma kuti anorasikirwa nekodzero yekudzima kubva panguva iyo basa rawanikwa zvizere. Kubvumirana uku nekubvuma zvinounganidzwawo panguva yekubhadhara.

6.3. 6.4. Zvikamu 6.1–6.3 hazvibvisi kana kudzikisira chero kodzero dzinopihwa mutemo unomanikidza kune vatengi uye dzisingagoni kuregererwa, kusanganisira mishonga yemutemo yekushaikwa kwekuenderana kwezviri mukati medhijitari nemasevhisi edhijitari (Directive (EU) 2019/770 uye kuitwa kwayo muPoland). sections.h: 7. BYOK Integrations, Chrome Extension ne MCP
sections.b:

8.2. Nekuisa mufananidzo kana kurekodha izwi, Mushandisi anomiririra uye anovimbisa kuti ndiye munhu akaratidzwa/akarekodhwa kana kuti ane mvumo yakajeka, yakaziviswa yemumwe munhu (uye, kune zvinhu zvine copyright, marezinesi akakodzera).

sections.h: 9. AI Features, Synthetic Content uye Transparency
sections.b:
9.1. Zvinhu zveAI zvePlatform zvinoshanda pamamodheru anowanikwa pachena evanopa masevhisi echitatu (Google Gemini, Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, HeyGen, ElevenLabs, FAL.ai) anodanwa kuburikidza neAPI dzepamutemo. Ruzivo rwekugadzirisa data rwakatsanangurwa mu Privacy Policy.

9.2. Zvirimo zvakagadzirwa neAI (ongororo, zvinyorwa, mazwi akakosha, voiceovers, mavhidhiyo) zvinogona kunge zvine zvikanganiso kana kusarurama uye hazvimiriri zano rehunyanzvi, remutemo, rekurapa kana rezvemari. Mushandisi anofanira kuongorora zvirimo zvakagadzirwa asati azvishandisa kana kuzvibudisa uye ane basa rakazara rekushandisa kwazvo.

9.3. Kuzivisa zvirimo zvakagadzirwa: kana Mushandisi achigadzira kana kugadzirisa mufananidzo, odhiyo kana vhidhiyo zvinonyatsofanana nevanhu varipo, zvinhu, nzvimbo kana zviitiko uye zvinogona kunyepa kuita sechokwadi kana chokwadi kumunhu (a "deep fake"), Mushandisi anofanira kujekesa uye kusiyanisa kuti zvirimo zvakagadzirwa kana kugadziriswa zvisina kunyanyisa, zvinoenderana neChikamu 50(4) cheEU AI Act nemitemo yemasocial network uko zvirimo zvakaburitswa. Kana vanopa AI vechitatu vakabatanidza zviratidzo zvinoverengwa nemuchina kana watermarks muzvirimo zvakagadzirwa, Mushandisi haafaniri kuzvibvisa kana kuzvivanza.

9.4. Mupi webasa haavimbise kuti zvirimo zvakagadzirwa neAI hazvina kodzero dzechitatu (semuenzaniso kana zvinyorwa zveMushandisi zvine zvinhu zvakachengetedzwa) uye haavimbise chero mhedzisiro yekutengeserana (maonero, kusvika, kuwana mari).

sections.h: 10. Zviri Mukati meMushandisi uye Pfuma yeNjere

Mushandisi anopa Mupi rezenisi risingasaruri, repasi rose rekugamuchira, kuchengeta, kugadzirisa, kugadzirisa uye kutumira zvinhu zvakadaro chete kusvika padanho rinodiwa kuti ape masevhisi ePlatform (kusanganisira kutumira kune vanopa AI uye masocial network akasarudzwa neMushandisi). Rezenisi rinopera kana zviri mukati kana account zvabviswa, kunze kwezvinyorwa zvinodiwa nemutemo.

10.2. Pakati peMupi neMushandisi, Mupi haatauri kodzero mune zvigadzirwa zvakagadzirirwa Mushandisi. Kodzero dzeMushandisi mune zvigadzirwa zveAI zvinotemerwa nemutemo unoshanda uye nemitemo yevanopa AI vechitatu vanobatanidzwa; Mushandisi ane basa rekuona kuti kushandiswa kwavo kwakarongwa kunobvumirwa.

10.3. Software yePlatform, dhizaini, zviratidzo uye madhatabhesi zvinoramba zviri zveMupi kana vanopa marezenisi ayo. Mitemo iyi haipi kodzero dzose kwavari kunze kwekodzero yekushandisa Platform sezvakarongwa.

10.4. Zviri mukati mechitatu zvinoratidzwa mukuongorora maitiro (mavhidhiyo, zvivharo, metrics zveTikTok/Instagram/YouTube) zvinoramba zviri zvevaridzi vekodzero nemapuratifomu; zvinoratidzwa pakuongorora musika. Chero kushandiswa kwezviri mukati zvakadaro neMushandisi (semuenzaniso, kukwidza zvakare vhidhiyo yemumwe munhu) kunoda hwaro hwemutemo hweMushandisi pachake.

sections.h: 11. Kudzivirirwa Kwe data; Kugadzirisa Pachinzvimbo cheMushandisi
sections.b:

11.2. 11.3. 1.2. Pamusoro pemacookies, TrendTraffic platform inoshandisa Local Storage yebrowser — pakati pezvimwe zvinhu, kuchengetedza token yekubvumidza yesession yako, mutauro wako uye dingindira reinterface, uye sarudzo yako yemvumo yecookie. Mutemo uyu unoshanda kumacookies uye Local Storage zvakafanana.

2.1. Zvinonyatsodiwa (zvehunyanzvi) — zvinodiwa kuti Platform ishande; zvinoshandiswa pahwaro hwechido cheMupi webasa uye hazvidi mvumo:

  • vibevox_user — cache yeprofile yemushandisi akapinda (Local Storage; kusvika wabuda);
  • tt_cookie_consent — inochengeta sarudzo yako yemvumo yecookie (Local Storage; kusvika waichinja kana kuibvisa).

2.2. Zvinoshanda (zvaunofarira):

  • i18nextLng — mutauro weinterface wakasarudzwa (Local Storage; kusvika wachinjwa kana kubviswa);

Nezvikonzero zvenhoroondo, zvimwe zvinongedzo zvinotakura "vibevox" prefix yechigadzirwa cheMupi webasa chekare; izvi ndezveTrendTraffic platform.

2.3. Analytics: Platform parizvino haisi kuisa hapana analytics yechitatu kana advertising trackers. Metrics ebasa akakosha, anodzivirira kuvanzika anounganidzwa server-side pasina cross-site tracking. Kana analytics yakavakirwa pamvumo ikamboiswa, ichashanda chete mushure mekunge wasarudza "Accept all".

2.4. Macookies echitatu: masevhisi ekunze akabatanidzwa muPlatform anogona kuisa macookies avo paunenge uchiashandisa:

  • Stripe — kuchengetedzwa kwekubhadhara uye kudzivirira hutsotsi pamapeji ekubhadhara (e.g. __stripe_mid, ~1 gore; __stripe_sid, ~30 maminitsi);
